themes.name: Dark (public blocks and info cards only)

tokens.name: imsda-navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Primary buttons, headings, active account tab, today in the calendar, focus ring on light surfaces. Navy text reads 11.8:1 on card; white on navy 11.8:1.

tokens.name: imsda-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deep navy. End of the staff rail gradient.

tokens.name: imsda-navy-soft
tokens.usage: Navy tint. Hover fills, count badges, open actions-menu trigger, calendar event chips (navy text on it).

tokens.name: imsda-purple
tokens.usage: Brand purple. Links and text buttons, field focus border, active club-portal tab underline, scan card. Purple text reads 10:1 on card and 8.5:1 on imsda-purple-soft.

tokens.name: imsda-purple-soft
tokens.usage: Purple tint. Purple status chips (Draft, Waitlisted, Cancelled, Billed to church), calendar entry chips.

tokens.name: imsda-gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold. Primary button on the public home hero (navy text, 6.3:1), the staff rail's current edge, the staff tab underline, focus ring on navy surfaces. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: imsda-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold tint. Gold status chips (amount due, waiting for approval) and warning notices, with gold-text or warning-text on it.

tokens.name: home-green
tokens.usage: Public home page only: the IMAdventist descriptor under the wordmark, section kickers and the green edges on place cards. 5.4:1 on card, 5.0:1 on paper.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Global :focus-visible outline, 3px with a 2px offset, on light surfaces.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus outline on navy surfaces: the staff rail, event and check-in heroes. Gold is 7.9:1 on navy-deep.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on paper, card and the soft tints.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata: 5.85:1 on card, 5.43:1 on paper, 4.97:1 on the tinted panels (stylesheet comment).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on cards, tables, chips and the calendar grid. Decorative only; not a field edge.

tokens.usage: Page background behind every workspace.

typeScale.note: The app's type-scale custom properties. The floors are 0 in print and rise on screen (12px helper text, 14px body); the staff workspace raises them again.

tokens.name: type-floor
tokens.usage: Smallest size for helper text, chips and captions: 0 in print, 12px (0.75rem) on screen. Declared as max(var(--type-floor, 0px), X). The staff workspace raises it to 14px.

tokens.name: type-body-floor
tokens.usage: Smallest size for body text, inputs, labels and buttons: 0 in print, 14px (0.875rem) on screen.

tokens.name: text-helper-min
tokens.usage: Smallest helper text size, 14px.
